item.title: Questions about FAA funding roil Capitol Hill after nationwide ground stop
item.description: Three days after a communications meltdown led the FAA to ground planes, there are big questions about what happened and how much money is needed to upgrade the country's air traffic control system.
item.content:encoded: Three days after a communications meltdown led the FAA to ground planes, there are big questions about what happened and how much money is needed to upgrade the country's air traffic control system.
item.dc:creator: Joel Rose

item.title: California sues OpenAI over hacking risks
item.description: The state's attorney general started investigating OpenAI after the Hugging Face attack and now says this attack was "entirely foreseeable" due to OpenAI's poor security practices.
item.content:encoded:
The state's attorney general started investigating OpenAI after the Hugging Face attack and now says this attack was "entirely foreseeable" due to OpenAI's poor security practices.

(Image credit: California Department of Justice)

item.title: If Robert Pattinson is James Bond, 007 needs to get a little weird
item.description: Amazon announced Monday that Robert Pattinson will be the next James Bond. NPR critic Glen Weldon says the idiosyncratic actor would seem to be a better fit as a Bond villain.

item.title: Pilot and journalist says fault lines beginning to show in U.S. air travel
item.description: NPR's Sacha Pfeiffer talks with James Fallows about his reporting on the safety of air travel, published in the New York Times Magazine the day before the nationwide ground stop.

item.title: U.S. tightens controls on remote access to AI technology amid Nvidia fallout
item.description: The new rule closes a loophole that existed that allowed Chinese companies to still access advanced AI chips remotely, despite U.S. restrictions on their physical sale to China.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: U.N. talks seek to rein in 'killer robots' as fears over AI weapons grow
item.description: Countries are meeting in Geneva to negotiate rules on weapons that can select and kill targets without human intervention. But with the U.S., Russia and Israel resisting legally binding controls, campaigners fear the window to act is closing.

item.title: A family runs afoul of the Russian mob in the terrific 'Paper Tiger'
item.description: Adam Driver, Scarlett Johansson and Miles Teller star in a film that isn't merely one of this year's very best films; it possesses a weight and depth you rarely find in American movies anymore.

item.description: "We were surrounded by extraordinary talent, but there can only be one 007," Denis Villeneuve, who will direct the new Bond film, said in an announcement from Amazon MGM Studios.
